notes: «مرة أخرى» is an editor's repeat-mark, left out

«وابن، جريج عن عطاء، عن صفوان بن يعلى، عن يعلى» is a second isnad carrying the same saying (the matn follows both): a second group; its head is written without a shaykh of its own, read as the text gives it
The bare «يعلى» is read as the one after each «صفوان بن يعلى» (first and second); the reading names no further man
